Required claim: for open Omega in R^n, 1 <= p < n, every u in W^{1,p}_0(Omega) satisfies ||u||_{L^{p*}(Omega)} <= C ||Du||_{L^p(Omega)} with C = C(n,p). Use: applied to the zero extensions of a bounded sequence to produce the uniform L^{p*} bound that the Lyapunov interpolation step consumes. Supplier is the batch-4 draft (PDE-14, order 458.025); hypotheses and constant must survive Step-3 authoring. Choice accounting: the supplier draft records def-axiom-of-choice; the consumer statement now carries the Axiom of Choice inherited through this inequality.

Required claim: p* = np/(n-p) with the scaling identity 1/p* = 1/p - 1/n for 1 <= p < n. Use: fixes the range 1 <= q < p* and the exponents in the interpolation 1/q = (1-theta)/p + theta/p*. Supplier is the batch-4 draft.

Required claim: on a bounded extension domain Omega and 1 <= p < n, ||u||_{L^q(Omega)} <= C ||u||_{W^{1,p}(Omega)} for all p <= q <= p*. Use: uniform L^{p*} bounds on the differences of the L^p-convergent subsequence, which the Lyapunov interpolation upgrades to strong L^q convergence for every q < p*. Supplier is the batch-4 draft. Choice accounting: the supplier draft records def-axiom-of-choice; the consumer statement now carries the Axiom of Choice inherited through this embedding.
Required claim: p* = np/(n-p) and the scaling identity for 1 <= p < n. Use: states the target range q < p* and the interpolation exponents. Supplier is the batch-4 draft.

Required claim: on a bounded extension domain Omega, ||u||_{L^q(Omega)} <= C(q) ||u||_{W^{1,n}(Omega)} for every finite q. Use: choose q' > q and bound the differences uniformly in L^{q'}; Lyapunov interpolation with the L^n-compactness gives L^q convergence. Supplier is the batch-4 draft; the blow-up of C(q) as q -> infinity is part of the statement and is used in the closing remark. Choice accounting: the supplier draft records def-axiom-of-choice; the consumer statement now carries the Axiom of Choice inherited through this embedding.

Required claim: for n < p < infinity the Morrey representative satisfies |u*(z)-u*(y)| <= C |z-y|^{1-n/p} ||Du||_{L^p(B(x,2r))} on balls with doubled ball in the domain. Use: applied to the extended and cut-off functions to get uniform C^{0,alpha} bounds and equicontinuity of the representatives on the compact domain, which Arzela-Ascoli and interpolation convert into C^{0,beta} compactness for beta < 1-n/p. Supplier is the batch-4 draft. Choice accounting: the supplier draft records def-axiom-of-choice; the consumer statement now carries the Axiom of Choice inherited through this inequality.

Required claim: for u in W^{k,p}(Omega) and |gamma| <= k, the class D^gamma u lies in W^{k-|gamma|,p}(Omega) with D^alpha D^gamma u = D^{alpha+gamma}u. Use: every D^gamma u with |gamma| <= k-1 is an element of W^{1,p}(Omega) to which the first-order compactness theorems apply, with ||D^gamma u||_{W^{1,p}} <= C ||u||_{W^{k,p}}. Supplier is the batch-4 draft.
